issues.description: Config check runs on every Return/Enter/Tab keypress instead of being cached or wired to a signal
issues.detail: self.get_conf('use_enter_for_completions', section='completions') is invoked inside keyPressEvent for every Tab/Return/Enter, even though the value rarely changes. In an interactive editor this is hot path code. Spyder's config system is fast but other widgets typically subscribe to conf changes (via on_conf_change / register_conf_observer) and cache the boolean as an instance attribute. Caching would also let the value be applied consistently when the user toggles the preference without restarting.

issues.description: No tests added for the new toggle behavior
issues.detail: Spyder has a test suite for the completion widget. A regression test asserting that (a) Enter accepts when the conf is True (existing behavior), (b) Enter is forwarded to the editor when the conf is False, and (c) Tab still accepts in both modes would prevent silent regressions. Without it, future refactors of the keyPressEvent if/elif ladder could trivially break the option.

issues.description: Conf page checkbox is registered without an explicit section
issues.detail: Every other checkbox in setup_page that targets a different section uses section='editor' explicitly (automatic_completion_box, completion_hint_box, code_snippets_box). The new use_enter_for_completions_box omits the section argument, relying on the PluginConfigPage default. This is presumably 'completions' so it matches the runtime get_conf call, but the inconsistency is a footgun: if a future refactor moves the page or changes the plugin's CONF_SECTION the option will silently bind to the wrong section. Pass section='completions' explicitly for symmetry with the other widgets and with the get_conf call in completion.py.

`not key == Qt.Key_Tab` is parsed correctly because == binds tighter than `not`, but PEP 8 and the rest of this file consistently use !=. The expression also reads more naturally combined with the preceding `not self.get_conf(...)` as `not enabled and key != Qt.Key_Tab`.

issues.description: New checkbox is not exposed via the keyboard shortcuts panel or surfaced in the tooltip with the actual Tab shortcut
issues.detail: The tooltip says 'completions will be accepted with the Tab key only' which is fine, but Spyder users often customize keybindings. If Tab is later rebound (it currently is not) the tooltip becomes misleading. Low priority — the current Tab handling is hardcoded in this same branch (Qt.Key_Tab) so the assumption holds for now.

issues.description: Layout reflow only updates rows 3 and 4, leaves remaining rows 5+ unverified in the diff
issues.detail: The patch shifts completions_after_characters from row 3 to row 4 and inserts use_enter_for_completions_box at row 3. The previously empty row 4 is now used, so no visible gap remains. Worth eyeballing the rendered settings page to confirm spacing matches the rest of the section, since the file has further rows (row 5 completions_hint_after_idle and beyond) that were not renumbered.

issues.description: No CHANGELOG / docs entry, and issue #12728 is the only stated motivation
issues.detail: User-facing preferences are normally mentioned in Spyder's changelog. The PR description is one line. Not blocking, but a reviewer should ask the author to add a one-liner to the appropriate changelog section so users discover the new option.

dissents.topic: Should the conf check be cached / observed instead of read on every keypress?

positions.position: Reading a conf value on every Tab/Enter is genuinely hot path in an editor; cache via a register_conf_observer subscription so the boolean lives on self as an attribute and toggles when the user changes the setting.

get_conf in Spyder is a dict lookup with negligible cost compared to a keypress round-trip and completion rendering. Optimizing here is premature; ship the simple inline check and only refactor if profiling shows it matters.

dissents.topic: Explicit section='completions' on the new checkbox vs trusting the page default

positions.position: Be explicit. The other newcb calls on this page that target non-default sections pass section= explicitly, and the get_conf call in completion.py also passes section='completions'. Symmetry prevents silent breakage if PluginConfigPage's default ever shifts.

The whole point of CONF_SECTION / page defaults is to avoid repeating the section everywhere. The conf page is the completion plugin's page, so the default is correct by construction; adding section='completions' is noise.

dissents.topic: not key == Qt.Key_Tab vs key != Qt.Key_Tab

positions.position: Use key != Qt.Key_Tab. PEP 8 recommends comparison operators over negation, and the rest of the file uses !=.
Both work and the precedence is unambiguous; flagging this is bikeshedding.

review.summary: The change is small, scoped, and behaviorally correct: a new boolean conf 'use_enter_for_completions' defaulting to True preserves existing behavior, and the keyPressEvent short-circuit lives inside the existing branch that handles only Return/Enter/Tab, so 'not key == Qt.Key_Tab' is safe in scope. Three P1 concerns: the conf is read on every keypress instead of being cached/observed, the new checkbox omits an explicit section='completions' that every neighboring conf widget passes explicitly (works today, fragile to refactor), and there are no tests covering the new toggle. P2 issues are stylistic (`key != Qt.Key_Tab`), documentation (changelog), and a layout sanity check. Reasonable to land after the section= explicitness fix and a basic test; the cache/observer refactor and style nit can be follow-ups.
